column3: *** ARCHIVO GENERAL DE LA NACION, MONTEVIDEO - 'PADRONES DE MONTEVIDEO Y EXTRAMUROS'. *** An entire reel of Montevideo censuses, in numbered *** volumenes ***, each covering one or more *** Libros ***: *** volumen 1 = Libros 2 y 334 *** (board at image 00004, filmed 29 Mar 2006); *** Libro 107 *** closes at image 02724; *** volumen 15 = Libro 256 *** opens at image 02725 (filmed 5 Apr 2006) and holds *** MARIA LLERENA, 60, Espanola, head of Casa 2, at image 02771. *** Project *** URUG NA01S, rollo 1 ***, photographer Cesar Graziani, 42X. *** The film leader gives the OLD MICROFILM NUMBER: 1263678. *** *** NEW TO THIS ARCHIVE - it was not among the 58 DGS numbers audited on 17 September ***, because nothing here had opened the Uruguayan census collection. *** MAPPED 20 September 2026 - eighteen DARK-FRAME CLUSTERS (candidate boundaries; a board is only one kind of dark frame) at images 4, 91, 125-127, 315, 563-565, 787, 959, 1073, 1215, 1315, 1475-1477, 1573-1575, 1847, 1961-1963, 2027, 2155, 2425, 2724-2725, found by measuring thumbnail brightness (boards 16-30, pages 140-156). *** See data/film-7499043-map.tsv. *** COMPLETED the same day: FIFTEEN VOLUMES, every boundary confirmed. *** Title boards at images 4, 126, 315, 563, 788, 959, 1215, 1315, 1475, 1574, 1847, 1962, 2155, 2425, 2725; each preceded by the FIN board of the volume before. Libros known for volumes 1 (2 y 334), 12 (465 y 255), 14 (107) and 15 (256).
